headline.en: Inspect the text overhead of tool envelopes.
headline.zh: 检查工具封装带来的文本开销。

sub.en: envelcost serializes configured tool-envelope templates, counts their text, and records profiles that can feed a capacity scenario.
sub.zh: envelcost 序列化配置的工具封装模板、计算文本 token，并记录可供容量情景使用的 profile。

body.en: You can inspect the exact serialization.
body.zh: 可以检查确切序列化内容。

body.en: Use the same tokenizer when comparing representations.
body.zh: 比较不同表示时可使用同一 tokenizer。

body.en: Capacity output remains a scenario over supplied ratios.
body.zh: 容量输出仍是基于给定比值的情景。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Serialize one complete read tool in compact and JSON-schema forms and count both with the same available cl100k tokenizer.
note.zh: 将一个完整 read 工具序列化为紧凑和 JSON-schema 形式，并使用同一个可用 cl100k tokenizer 统计。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Serialize one explicit tool definition in two project representations and count both with the same available cl100k tokenizer. No real harness capture, model execution, GPU capacity or preserved tool-schema equivalence.

body.en: Serialize one complete read tool in compact and JSON-schema forms and count both with the same available cl100k tokenizer.
body.zh: 将一个完整 read 工具序列化为紧凑和 JSON-schema 形式，并使用同一个可用 cl100k tokenizer 统计。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/envelcost.git
cd envelcost
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: The envelope templates are project models, not captures proving the behavior of named current harnesses.
limitations.zh: 封装模板是项目建模，不是证明当前同名调用框架行为的抓包记录。

limitations.en: The compact form omits recursive schema details retained by JSON. Smaller text does not establish equivalent tool-calling behavior.
limitations.zh: 紧凑形式省略 JSON 保留的递归 schema 细节；文本更小不证明工具调用行为等价。

limitations.en: Token ratios alone do not measure throughput or GPU seat capacity. Capacity and cost outputs depend on assumed coefficients and registry data.
limitations.zh: token 比值不能单独测量吞吐或 GPU 座位容量；容量和费用输出依赖假设系数与登记数据。

body.en: A verbose tool schema adds input text before the task itself. Comparing the actual serialized representations exposes what was counted and which schema information each representation retains.
body.zh: 冗长工具 schema 会在任务本身之前增加输入文本。比较实际序列化表示，可以看清统计了什么，以及各表示保留了哪些 schema 信息。

body.en: ToolDef supplies compact and JSON-schema serializations. EnvelopeConfig combines them with task and turn wrappers. Tokenizer counts the selected representation; Runner stores EnvelopeProfile records, and Projector applies configured capacity assumptions to their ratios.
body.zh: ToolDef 提供紧凑与 JSON-schema 序列化。EnvelopeConfig 与任务、轮次包装组合，Tokenizer 计算 token，Runner 保存 EnvelopeProfile，Projector 按配置容量假设使用这些比值。

body.en: ToolDef supplies compact and JSON-schema serializations. EnvelopeConfig combines them with task and turn wrappers. Tokenizer counts the selected representation; Runner stores EnvelopeProfile records, and Projector applies configured capacity assumptions to their ratios.
body.zh: ToolDef 提供紧凑与 JSON-schema 序列化。EnvelopeConfig 与任务、轮次包装组合，Tokenizer 计算 token，Runner 保存 EnvelopeProfile，Projector 按配置容量假设使用这些比值。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: run accepts a configured harness list and task selection; its default path is offline template tokenization. Optional online mode makes real requests. Tokenizer fallback can use character-based estimates, so retain which tokenizer was available when comparing profiles.
body.zh: run 接收配置封装列表和任务选择，默认是离线模板分词；可选在线模式会实际请求。Tokenizer 回退可能使用字符估算，因此比较 profile 时应保留实际可用 tokenizer 信息。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
envelcost run
envelcost report
# Scenario projection, not a load test:
envelcost project --gpus 8xH100 --seats 50

changelog.zh: v0.8.0：envelcost --version 现在报对版本号（包 __version__ 常量此前卡在 0.6.0，与 VERSION/pyproject 不一致，演示 gif 也跟着错版）；envelcost-report.md 的方差判定门现在如实反映 floor_evaluable——单 harness 运行不再被写成 'kill floor held: True'，而是 'skipped (<2 harnesses)'，与 CLI stdout 一致，写出来的报告不再误导。
changelog.en: v0.8.0: envelcost --version now reports the correct version (the package __version__ constant was stuck at 0.6.0, out of sync with VERSION/pyproject, so the demo gif showed the wrong version too); the envelcost-report.md variance gate now honestly reflects floor_evaluable — a single-harness run is no longer written as 'kill floor held: True' but as 'skipped (<2 harnesses)', matching the CLI stdout so the persisted report no longer misleads.

changelog.zh: v0.7.0：store 的两处 json.loads 读取循环（_store 重读 + load_profiles）现在 try/except 跳过坏行并告警——profiles.jsonl 里一行损坏（遗留的非原子追加、手改、外部损坏）不再让 report/project 整个崩掉；下一次 run 的原子重写顺手自愈坏行。
changelog.en: v0.7.0: both json.loads read loops in the store (_store re-read + load_profiles) now try/except-skip-and-warn bad lines — a single corrupt line in profiles.jsonl (legacy pre-atomic append, manual edit, external corruption) no longer bricks report/project; the next run's atomic rewrite self-heals the bad line.

changelog.zh: v0.6.0：online usage 的 shape 校验收紧（异常用量不再被静默算成零）；tokenizer 不再硬编码 trust_remote_code，移除未受信远程代码的信任面。
changelog.en: v0.6.0: tightened the online usage shape check (an anomalous usage no longer silently zeroes); the tokenizer no longer hard-codes trust_remote_code, removing the untrusted-remote-code surface.

changelog.zh: v0.5.0 修复了 project 摘要：单 harness store 不再误报 'deepseek-native does NOT fit'（基线现在按 1.0x parity 投影）。--gpus 校验：打错的（H100x8）、0（0xH100）、负数（-2xH100）现在抛干净错误，不再是 traceback 或静默的 0/负 capex 投影。新增 envelcost project --json 机器可读容量投影，对齐 report 已有的 JSON 输出。
changelog.en: v0.5.0 fixes the project summary so a single-harness store no longer falsely reports 'deepseek-native does NOT fit' (it now projects the baseline at 1.0x parity). --gpus validation: a typoed (H100x8), zero (0xH100), or negative (-2xH100) count now raises a clean error instead of a traceback or a silently bogus 0/negative-capex projection. Adds envelcost project --json for machine-readable capacity projection, mirroring the JSON output report already ships.

changelog.zh: m1 方差判定门现在测量真实的跨测试集离散度（而非相对基线的最大值），排除基线的双测试集运行不再会静默放行。--task 逗号列表里匹配不到任何任务的部分现在会明确报错，而不再悄悄只跑子集。
changelog.en: The m1 variance kill gate now measures true cross-harness spread (not max-vs-baseline), so a 2-harness run excluding the baseline can no longer silently hold. A --task comma-list part matching nothing now raises a clear error instead of quietly running a subset.

zh: offline（默认）run 现在尊重 --task——过滤条件透进 run_benchmark，点名哪道任务就只跑哪道；之前 offline 路径不带 task_ids，--task 在 offline 是死选项（v0.2.0 只修了 online 那半）。
store 不再追加重复行——改为按 (task, harness) 去重替换 + 原子重写，重复 envelcost run 只刷新不堆叠，report/project 永远只反映最新一次测算，文件也不再无限增长（v0.2.0 延期的中置信度 bug，现高置信度修复）。
en: The offline (default) run now respects --task — the filter threads into run_benchmark, so naming a task runs only that one; previously the offline path passed no task_ids, making --task a dead option in offline mode (v0.2.0 only fixed the online half).

The store no longer appends duplicate rows — it now upserts by (task, harness) with an atomic rewrite, so a repeated envelcost run refreshes in place instead of stacking, and report/project always reflect the latest measurement with no unbounded file growth (the medium-confidence bug deferred in v0.2.0, now fixed at high confidence).

zh: --online 现在尊重 --harnesses 和 --task——过滤条件穿透进 run_online，只为你选中的 (harness, task) 对走付费 DeepSeek API，不再把整张 5 任务 × 3 envelope 网格计费；--task 在任何付费调用前就被解析校验，打错当场 BadParameter、一分不花。
跨 envelope 的 kill floor 不再被单 harness 运行假性证伪——新增 floor_evaluable 门控：不足 2 个 harness 时跳过 kill gate，退出干净。
en: --online now respects --harnesses and --task — the filter threads into run_online, billing only the (harness, task) pairs you selected through the paid DeepSeek API instead of the full 5-task × 3-envelope grid; --task is resolved and validated before any paid call, so a typo surfaces as BadParameter at $0.
The cross-envelope kill floor is no longer falsely falsified by a single-harness run — a new floor_evaluable gate skips the kill floor when fewer than 2 harnesses ran, exiting clean.
